title: El Estado de las Autonomías y la solidaridad territorial
goal: Comprender la organización territorial de España en municipios, provincias, 17 comunidades autónomas y 2 ciudades autónomas.

items: Explain how Article 2 combines the unity of the Spanish Nation with the right to autonomy and solidarity among regions.
Describe Spain's territorial organization into municipalities, provinces, 17 Autonomous Communities, and 2 Autonomous Cities (Ceuta and Melilla).
Define the Statute of Autonomy as the basic institutional norm of each Autonomous Community.
Use 'si bien' + indicative to express formal concession.
I can explain how Article 2 combines the unity of the Spanish Nation with the right to autonomy and solidarity among regions.
I can describe Spain's territorial organization into municipalities, provinces, 17 Autonomous Communities, and 2 Autonomous Cities (Ceuta and Melilla).
I can define the Statute of Autonomy as the basic institutional norm of each Autonomous Community.
I can use 'si bien' + indicative to express formal concession.
